item.description: - Desktop widgets no longer go blank after an update: Dashbar now restarts its widget when it launches as a new version.

- GitHub Copilot support, in the terminal and as VS Code's agent: its sessions show in your workspaces as working, idle or asking permission, with notifications, the island and the menu bar like any agent. A Usage card and History show its tokens, models and premium requests, updated as Copilot works. Add Dashbar's hook in Settings → Integrations to see when a session needs you the moment it asks. - A Show in Dashbar switch for each tool in Settings → Integrations: Codex, Gemini CLI and Antigravity, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot. Switched off, a tool is hidden everywhere and Dashbar stops reading its files; switch it back on and everything returns.

- OpenCode support: its sessions show in your workspaces as working or idle, with a Usage card for its tokens, models and estimated cost. Add Dashbar's plugin in Settings → Integrations to also see when a session is waiting for you. - Settings → Integrations is shorter: one section per tool, each with its Add or Remove button, and the details of what Dashbar changes folded underneath.
